name: Spider
tagline: Spider solitaire with 1, 2 or 4 suits. Your deal is saved.
description:
Close it mid-game, open it tomorrow — the same ten piles, the same score.

Build king-to-ace runs. A finished same-suit run of 13 leaves the tableau; eight of those and you win. Deal a row from the stock only when every pile has a card — the real Spider rule, not a house rule. 1-suit is the teacher, 2-suit is the middle, 4-suit is the game Microsoft players mean.

Tap a face-up card and tap where it goes, or drag. Empty piles take any run. Undo puts the cards back. A phone-sized tableau fans so you can still read the ranks.

An unofficial port of spider-solitaire by lklynet. Same engine; this copy adds the 1/2/4-suit deals.
